description: C2HLS_ENFORCEMENT overlay only. Wrap the accepted flash kernel with tile DATAFLOW. Do not replace flash 512-bit LANES=16 loads or the flash compute nest. Not mixed into the flash 90-skill dump. Not the post-flash DSE PE pack or the stream FIFO pack.

skills.pattern: flash already loads/stores 64x64 float in ~256 cycles via LANES=16 (k0 += LANES, UNROLL u, max_widen_bitwidth=512). Enforcement rewrites those loops to scalar PIPELINE II=1 over j,k and load_B becomes ~4096.
skills.strategy: Copy the flash load/store bodies. Keep LANES=16. Keep max_widen_bitwidth=512. Keep the UNROLLed lane loop. For tiles, only shrink the outer trip (TI rows) — the inner walk is still k0 += LANES. A 64x64 scalar II=1 copy is a defect even if Vitis later reports 512-bit widening.
required_steps: keep `const int LANES = 16` (or equivalent 512/element_bits)
keep inner index `k0 += LANES` / `j0 += LANES` with `#pragma HLS UNROLL` on the lane loop
keep distinct gmem0/gmem1/gmem2 and max_widen_bitwidth=512
if tiling A/C, copy the same LANES walk onto A_buf[TI][K] / C_buf[TI][J]
load_B once with the flash 512-bit body (~256 cycles), never a 64x64 scalar walk
guards: automatic m_axi widening does not shrink a C loop that still stores one float per cycle
csynth load_B ~4171 after flash load_B ~259 means this skill was ignored
do not emit memcpy_wide_bus_* or change top pointer types

skills.pattern: flash compute is already iso-compute (~320 DSP): full-K adder tree (dot64) or PE×SIMD with affine write-once C. Enforcement replaces it with a weaker nest or keeps DSP but serializes K.
skills.strategy: Copy the flash compute function body into compute_tile. Only change the i range to the tile (TI or PE rows). Keep ARRAY_PARTITION, UNROLL K or SIMD, PIPELINE II=1 on the independent j loop, write-once C_buf. Do not invent a new MAC schedule.
required_steps: paste flash compute (dot64 / PE nest) into compute_tile
keep the same UNROLL / ARRAY_PARTITION / write-once C assignment
csynth DSP must stay within 15% of flash DSP
do not pipeline a k-recurrence on one C[i][j]
guards: dropping DSP from ~318 to tens means the compute nest was deleted
this is not the stream mm_pe FIFO pack

skills.pattern: flash is sequential local-A/B/C (good LCST, ~4808) with no tile DATAFLOW. Judge wants load(t+1)/compute(t)/store(t-1) overlap without throwing away the flash rooms.
skills.strategy: Keep flash load_B (full B, LANES=16). Split flash load_A / compute / store_C onto NT=2 row tiles. `#pragma HLS DATAFLOW` inside `for (t < NT)`. Declare A_buf/C_buf **inside** that loop. INLINE-off the three tasks. Target kernel ≤ flash latency: load_B ~256 + parent ≈ NT*max(tile_load, tile_compute, tile_store).
required_steps: start from the flash kernel in the prompt, do not start from a scalar skeleton
NT=2 (or 4) large tiles, not 64 one-row tiles
declare tile arrays inside the DATAFLOW loop (HLS 214-397 if outside)
keep flash LANES loads and flash compute
one-call latency must not exceed flash × 1.10
guards: DATAFLOW around one full-matrix load/compute/store is the 12893 fail
interval < latency is the next kernel launch, not in-GEMM overlap
do not emit mm_pe / C_ring / packed FIFO systolic I/O

skills.pattern: repair emits `for (j) for (k) { #pragma HLS PIPELINE II=1; B_local[j][k] = B[j][k]; }` after flash already had LANES=16
skills.strategy: Reject the scalar copy. Restore the flash LANES walk. Csynth load ~4096 after flash ~259 is this anti-pattern.
required_steps: detect inner k++ / j++ scalar AXI copy under PIPELINE II=1
replace with k0 += LANES and UNROLL u < LANES
do not keep both; the scalar loop wins in HLS
guards: Vitis may still print BURST_VERBOSE_WIDEN_PASSED on a scalar loop; latency stays ~4096

skills.pattern: legal tile DATAFLOW whose one-call latency is worse than the flash kernel (12642 vs 4808). Overlap of three ~2100-cycle rooms plus a 4171 load_B prefix.
skills.strategy: If ping-pong cannot beat or match flash within 10%, do not submit. Restore flash loads (so tile I/O is ~128 not ~2100) and keep flash compute. Judge fails kernel > flash×1.10 even if rooms overlap.
required_steps: compare candidate latency_cycles to the flash baseline in the prompt
if candidate > flash×1.10, rewrite from the flash kernel, not from the last attempt
tile I/O must stay LANES-wide so it is shorter than compute
guards: parent < 0.85×N×sum is not enough if the kernel is slower than flash
do not treat interval as the result
